data_vintages.vacancies: NYC DOF reporting year 2025; later available 2026 status is used where reported

mta_subway_ridership.where: borough='Manhattan' AND transit_mode='subway' AND transit_timestamp in [2026-08-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-01T00:00:00)
mta_subway_ridership.aggregation: 31 daily Socrata queries; sum ridership by station complex per day, then mean over observed dates

dohmh_restaurant_inspections.where: boro='Manhattan' AND (cuisine_description='Coffee/Tea' OR upper(dba) like '%STARBUCKS%' OR upper(dba) like '%DUNKIN%' OR upper(dba) like '%BLUESTONE%' OR upper(dba) like '%JOE COFFEE%' OR upper(dba) like '%BLUE BOTTLE%' OR upper(dba) like '%PRET%' OR upper(dba) like '%GREGORYS%' OR upper(dba) like '%TIM HORTONS%' OR upper(dba) like '%COFFEE PROJECT%' OR upper(dba) like '%MAMAN%' OR upper(dba) like '%VARIETY COFFEE%' OR upper(dba) like '%BLANK STREET%' OR upper(dba) like '%COTTI%' OR upper(dba) like '%LUCKIN%')

sources.store_status_note: Luckin locations are unique DOHMH inspection/establishment records; current operating status was not independently confirmed from the chain locator.

nyc_dof_storefronts.source_description: DOF storefront registrations; includes both vacant and non-vacant storefronts.
nyc_dof_storefronts.vacancy_rule: vacant_6_30_or_date_sold=YES, or blank with vacant_on_12_31=YES; exclude construction_reported=YES; valid Manhattan coordinates; collapse rounded 6-decimal coordinate duplicates

limitations: DOHMH inspection records do not independently establish that an establishment is currently open.
Luckin locations are provisional DOHMH records; the official chain locator was not reachable during retrieval.
DOF coordinates are storefront/building-level geocodes, not verified entrance coordinates.
DOF source does not provide asking rent or reusable fit-out status; the model's $9/sf/month rent fallback and fit-out flag are assumptions, not measurements.
LODES workplace jobs and subway entries are demand proxies, not observed coffee purchases.
